images.name: cover
images.title: The *AI accounts receivable* clerk
images.sub: Invoices out on time, reminders on a schedule, payments matched, and the decisions that stay with a person.

images.name: duties
images.title: Accounts receivable, *duty by duty*
rows: Builds each invoice from the time tracker or order system and sends it the day it's billable.
Confirms it was opened, uploads to the customer's portal, fixes a missing PO number.
Follows the written schedule. Checks the bank feed before every send.
Resends copies, logs promised dates. Stops reminders on any dispute.
Applies each payment to its invoices. Lists short payments with a question.
Passes the request along with the payment history. A person decides.

images.name: schedule
images.title: An example *reminder schedule*
head: When
What goes out
Who sends it
rows: A short note with the invoice and a payment link
A check that it reached the right person
A firmer note that asks for a payment date
A statement of every open invoice, copied to the account owner
Reminders stop. The account goes over with its full history
images.source: Example. Every business sets its own timing and wording.

images.name: tuesday
images.title: A Tuesday at a *25-person IT services firm*
rows: Applies four overnight payments. One $18,240 transfer covers four invoices.
Sends 11 invoices for project tickets closed on Monday.
Last week's invoice bounced. Finds the new payables contact and resends.
A customer says the migration wasn't finished. Reminders stop.
Uploads three invoices to a customer's payables portal with the PO numbers.
A customer asks to split $9,600 over three months.
One account reaches 45 days late. Handed over with its history.

images.name: setup
images.title: How an AI accounts receivable clerk *is set up*
steps: Time tracker, timesheets, orders or contracts, and the rate each one bills at.
The timing, the wording, and the day it stops and hands over.
Who always pays on day 44, who needs a portal upload, who gets a call instead.
Accounting software, bank feed, billing inbox. No access to move money.
Disputes, payment plans, credit holds and write-offs go to a named person.
Shadow for two or three weeks
It drafts every invoice and reminder while a person approves each one.
